purpose: Teach: 符号/執拗/再三/先々/最長/怠慢/随所/つくろ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無線符号の解読技術もお持ちですね
lines.en: The police, you have expertise in decoding radio communications, don't you.
lines.style: Conversational, respectful curiosity. Steady pace. Leaning in with genuine interest, as if asking a knowledgeable person to confirm what he's heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、執拗なストーカー事件も扱われますね
lines.en: The police also handle persistent stalker cases, I imagine.
lines.style: Same warm, collaborative tone. Light on the ending—not quite a question, more an observation he's inviting confirmation on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、再三の注意でも従わない者には厳格に対処されますね
lines.en: When people don't heed repeated warnings, you deal with them strictly, don't you.
lines.style: Conversational acknowledgment. Slight emphasis on the consequence—not accusatory, just factual. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、先々の犯罪傾向を予測されますね
lines.en: You must be able to anticipate crime trends before they happen.
lines.style: Admiring tone, almost thoughtful. Slower pace on this one—he's genuinely impressed. Slight pause before the end, as if seeing the skill clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、最長級の捜査もご経験ですね
lines.en: You've worked on some of the longest investigations, I'd think.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. No edge—just acknowledging something substantial. Steady, easy delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、怠慢な対応は内部告発で改善されますね
lines.en: Internal whistleblowers help fix things when there's negligence, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, not quite judgment. Measured pace. Slight hesitation—he's observing the system's self-correction, a little in awe of how it works.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場の随所に証拠が残るものですね
lines.en: Evidence tends to turn up all over the crime scene.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Not lecturing—just acknowledging what he understands about how investigations work. Simple, steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、旧手法をつくろう新捜査法も導入されますね
lines.en: And of course you're always adopting newer investigative methods to replace the old ones.
lines.style: Gentle, admiring. Slight warmth on "of course"—he's acknowledging the constant improvement. Calm, assured delivery.
